area.help: Draw the region your community covers. People can still pan and zoom anywhere on the map, but they can only add things inside this area. Leave it empty to allow contributions everywhere.
area.mapLabel: Map for drawing the community area

area.drawingHint_other: {{count}} corners placed. Click the map to add corners around your region, then finish (at least 3).
area.editHint_other: {{count}} corners. Drag a corner to move it, drag a small midpoint to add a corner, double-click a corner to remove it. Save the settings to apply.
area.cornerHint: Drag to move, double-click to remove
area.midpointHint: Drag to add a corner here
area.crosses: The outline crosses itself. Move a corner so the edges do not cross, or the area cannot be saved.

settingsAdmin.privacyHelp: Shown on the Privacy policy page. Empty means the template is shown. Same formatting as the About text.

moderation.title: Waiting for review

people.title: People
people.intro: Roles decide what somebody may do. Only a superadmin can change them.
people.name: Name
people.blocked: {{name}} is blocked and has been signed out.
people.blockConfirmBody: They are signed out everywhere straight away and cannot sign in again until unblocked. What they added stays on the map.
people.newPasswordConfirmBody: Their current password stops working and they are signed out everywhere. You get a temporary password to hand over - in person or by phone, not in a public message.
people.temporaryExplain: Give it to {{name}} and ask them to sign in with it and change their password under Your account.
people.temporaryOnce: It is shown only now. If you close this window, you will have to make a new one.

about.title: About
about.contributeBody: Create an account, choose a topic, then click the map to place what you want to add. Everything is checked by a moderator before it appears, and you can suggest changes to places that are already on the map.
about.whyBody: You do not have to change the world on your own. Most of the difference is made by everyday choices, close to home - and they are easier when you know where to go.
about.whyLocal: Buy local: farm shops and roadside stalls cut transport and keep the money on the island.
about.whyRepair: Repair, swap and buy second-hand before you buy new.
about.whyMove: Walk, cycle or take the bus when you can - and charge the car where the wind blows.
about.whyShare: Share what you know: a good place on the map helps the next person choose green.
about.whyClose: This map is made by the people who live here. Every place someone adds makes the green choice a little easier for everybody else.
about.openDataPlaces: The places on the map come from {osm} - a free map of the world made by volunteers. Data is © OpenStreetMap contributors and freely available under the {licence}.
about.openDataFix: Is a place wrong or closed? Suggest a change here on the map - or fix it directly in OpenStreetMap, so everyone who uses it benefits. We check the places against OpenStreetMap a few times a year.
about.openDataTiles: The background maps come from Esri, OpenStreetMap, OpenTopoMap and CyclOSM - the source is shown in the map's bottom corner.

errors.bad_request: That request could not be handled.

avatar.title: Profile picture
avatar.intro: Pick a photo, then move and zoom it until it sits nicely in the circle.
avatar.instructions: Drag to move the photo, zoom with the slider, the mouse wheel or two fingers. With the keyboard: arrow keys move it, + and − zoom, R turns it.
avatar.notImage: Choose an image file - a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.
avatar.fileTooLarge: That photo is over 20 MB. Choose a smaller one.
avatar.unreadable: That photo could not be read. Try a JPEG or PNG.

invite.title: Invite someone
invite.intro: You get a link to send them however you like - email, chat or a text message. They choose their own password.
invite.label: Who is it for?
invite.labelHelp: Their name, so you can tell your invitations apart. They can change it.
invite.readyIntro: Send this link to the person you are inviting. It works once.
invite.copied: Copied. Paste it into a message to them.
invite.onlyOnce: This link is shown only now. If it gets lost, withdraw the invitation and make a new one.

roleHelp.viewer: Can look at the map, but not add anything.
roleHelp.contributor: Can add places, routes and areas, and edit their own.
roleHelp.moderator: Can also review, edit and remove anyone’s contributions.
roleHelp.admin: Can also manage layers, settings and people.

welcome.title: Welcome to {{name}}

welcome.howTo: Tap a topic at the top of the map, or a place to learn more about it.

exportData.title: Export the map's content
exportData.intro: Download every place, route and area as a file - including those waiting for review and those on hidden layers. GeoJSON opens in map tools such as QGIS; CSV opens in Excel or Google Sheets. Photos are included as links.

deleteAccount.title: Delete your account
deleteAccount.intro: Your account, name, e-mail and profile picture are deleted straight away, and you are signed out. Suggestions not yet reviewed go too. This cannot be undone.

deleteAccount.alsoPlacesHelp: Otherwise they stay on the map without your name - as "added by a former member".

deleteAccount.confirmKeep: Your account is deleted. The places you added stay on the map without your name.
deleteAccount.confirmWithPlaces: Your account is deleted - and every place and photo you added with it.
deleteAccount.done: Your account is deleted. Thank you for taking part.
deleteAccount.lastSuperadmin: You are the only superadmin. Make someone else superadmin first (People), so the map is not left without one.
